function.description: Read the approved clinical scope overview: patient fields, one current record or the patient's source-linked records and timeline, scope limits and representative frame map.

function.description: Read the recorded clinical measurements: tool, name, distanceCm/areaCm2, source frame indexes, point counts and attached notes. Bounded list.
function.name: get_measurements

function.description: Read structured patient-, record- and measurement-level clinical notes.
function.name: get_notes

function.description: Read integrity status: original capture presence/validity and the clinical revision version and signature state.
function.name: get_integrity
